# Extras for the probing env, installed under obtune's lock as constraints (-c). A package
# pinned in the lock cannot move; if an extra conflicts, it goes in a separate env, never here.
matplotlib
seaborn
statsmodels
pypdf        # read papers/ without a poppler install
tqdm
scikit-learn
pypdfium2  # PDF page rasteriser for checking built papers (2026-09-17)
